round1.reason: acceptance-bound policy requires explicit depth-0 authority for every non-exact finding

seats.findings:
🟠 [coupon-pct-lower-bound] MUST-FIX src/coupon.js:4 clamps pct with Math.max(1, pct), so pct=0 yields a 1 percent discount instead of 0; this also corrupts checkoutTotal for uncouponed orders; change Math.max(1, pct) to Math.max(0, pct)
🟠 [ship-zero-weight] MUST-FIX src/ship.js:4 only returns 0 for negative weight, so shippingCents(0) returns 500 instead of the contracted 0; this also inflates checkoutTotal for weight 0; change the guard to weightG <= 0

🟠 [coupon-clamp-lower-bound] MUST-FIX src/coupon.js:4 pct is clamped with Math.max(1, pct), i.e. to 1..100, but the contract limits pct to 0..100; a pct of 0 (no coupon) produces a spurious 1% discount (couponCents(2500, 0) returns 25 instead of 0) and the error propagates into checkoutTotal via src/checkout.js:5-6 (checkoutTotal(1000, 0, 0, 0) computes taxable 990 instead of 1000); smallest remediation: change Math.max(1, pct) to Math.max(0, pct)
🟠 [ship-zero-weight-charged] MUST-FIX src/ship.js:4 the guard is `weightG < 0`, so weight 0 falls through to `500 + Math.ceil(...)` and returns 500, but the contract returns 0 for weight 0; every weight-0 order is overcharged 500 cents and checkoutTotal inherits it (checkoutTotal(1000, 0, 0, 0) adds 500 shipping instead of 0); smallest remediation: change the condition to `weightG <= 0`

🟠 [coupon-min-clamp] MUST-FIX src/coupon.js:4 — Math.max(1, pct) clamps pct to a minimum of 1, but the spec says pct is limited to 0..100; a pct of 0 must yield a discount of 0, yet the code computes a discount as if pct were 1. Impact: checkoutTotal (which delegates here) also overcharges a discount when pct is 0. Remediation: change Math.max(1, pct) to Math.max(0, pct).
🟠 [ship-zero-weight] MUST-FIX src/ship.js:4 — the guard is weightG < 0, so weightG === 0 falls through and returns 500 (500 + Math.ceil(0/500)*100). The spec requires shippingCents(0) to return 0. Impact: checkoutTotal also returns an incorrect total for zero-weight orders. Remediation: change the guard to weightG <= 0.
